description: Na₂Hf(HO)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of three Na₂Hf(HO)₆ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.46 Å) and three longer (2.47 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Hf is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Hf-O bond lengths are 2.09 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hf, and one H atom.
